title: Counter-Strike 2

custody.physical: Steam digital edition · free-to-play competitive title
custody.condition: Licensed copy held on the archive Steam account. No optical disc or boxed materials accompany this filing.

curatorNotes: Open for curator writing on Counter-Strike 2 as the present Counter-Strike filing on this shelf.
collectionNotes: Steam license under the archive account; no physical counterpart. Official cover artwork is on file from Steam library art. Photography of a boxed copy is not applicable.

preservation.playableOn: Windows or Linux through Steam under archive custody, subject to online matchmaking services
preservation.compatibility: Access depends on Steam custody and on Valve’s continued support for Counter-Strike 2.
preservation.concerns: Account binding, client obsolescence, and online-service dependency. No offline installer is retained.
preservation.knownRevisions: Counter-Strike 2 released September 27, 2023 on Steam App 730, replacing Counter-Strike: Global Offensive on that storefront listing. The Steam storefront chronology for App 730 still reflects the earlier CS:GO listing date (August 21, 2012); this accession records the Counter-Strike 2 release.
preservation.availability: Accessible through the archive Steam account while the title remains offered for that account.

connections.futureReview: Reserved for future critical writing in Bloodsoaked Media.

steam.shortDescription: For over two decades, Counter-Strike has offered an elite competitive experience, one shaped by millions of players from across the globe. And now the next chapter in the CS story is about to begin. This is Counter-Strike 2.

synopsis: Valve’s Counter-Strike 2 on Steam — the current Counter-Strike title retained under the archive Steam account.
